name: Reza
self_text: Hi! I'm Reza, a non-binary German in my 40s. When I'm not out with my Leica, I usually spend my time watching old westerns, which I find incredibly relaxing. I'm honestly just looking for a structured instruction session. As for editing, I don't need any post-processing lesson this time. I'm also cool with not taking portraits of each other during our time together. Most weeks, I can do Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a structured instruction session. It would be a small bonus if you are available Saturday afternoon, and it's also nice if you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, but no big deal.
